decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets identified: (1) a multi-component jump starting ~538 (N↑, U↑, E↓) sustained through 543 with no return observed in context; (2) an isolated E step at 576 without clear sustained interior or return. Both lack confirmed opposing returns within allowed context [501,579], so both are marked uncertain. No interval meets full confirmation criteria (clear onset, sustained interior, and unambiguous opposing return on affected axes).

intervals.observation: N and U rise sharply across indices 538–543 (e.g., N jumps from ~2.1 to ~9.2, U from ~-3.9 to ~7.6), E drops concurrently (from ~-9.1 to ~-2.3). The change is multi-sample, sustained over ≥5 samples, and cross-axis coherent. No opposing return observed within allowed context [501,579]; the signal remains elevated through index 543 and beyond. Return not observed before context end → status uncertain.

At index 576, E shows a sharp downward step (~+4.1 in N, -7.2 in E, +1.4 in U), but N and U do not show a matching sustained offset; instead, N/E/U are already in a new regime since ~544. The E step at 576 lacks a clear opposing return within context and is isolated—no sustained platform or recovery observed. Status uncertain due to ambiguous onset/return pairing and coexistence with prior motion.
